method: Original full image viewed alongside browser-only pixel-scale weapon screenshots; no original image processing

findings: A new standing shoulder-fire pose replaces the earlier low diagonal carry.
Stock, receiver, handguard, exposed barrel and muzzle form one consistent near-horizontal rigid assembly; no visible bend at the support hand or barrel junction.
Upper rail and sight remain aligned with the firearm; the weapon is fully visible through the muzzle.
The firing hand closes around the pistol grip with index at the trigger; the support hand wraps the lower handguard; buttstock meets the shoulder region.
characters.visualWeaponAssessment: No visible bend or disconnected grip found in the reviewed V3 image. Final artistic approval remains with the user.

findings: The sword is now held upright beside the body, replacing the earlier downward diagonal pose.
Pommel, grip, center of guard and long blade share a continuous near-vertical axis with no visible hilt-to-blade kink.
The blade edges remain straight through the taper to the tip; decorative bat guard is distinct from the blade geometry.
A closed gloved hand wraps the grip directly beneath the guard; fingers and wrist connect to the sword hand.
characters.visualWeaponAssessment: No visible bend or open/disconnected sword grip found in the reviewed V3 image. Final artistic approval remains with the user.
